content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DCBH Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Deep Chand Bandhu Hospital is scheduled for 17 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DCBH for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Deep Chand Bandhu Hospital has announced a total of 10 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts. These vacancies are spread across various specializations as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB, Diploma) in the concerned disciplines to be eligible for the Senior Resident positions. Specific qualifications may vary slightly for certain posts like Obs/Gynae.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the DCBH Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for the Senior Resident recruitment at Deep Chand Bandhu Hospital. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 67700 to Rs. 208700 per month, as per the pay matrix and allowances applicable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Senior Resident posts at DCBH?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the designated venue on the specified date with all required original documents and photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for DCBH Senior Resident recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Deep Chand Bandhu Hospital, Delhi. The exact address and reporting time will be available in the official notification, which can be accessed via the links provided.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, mark sheets, degree/diploma certificates, experience certificates (if any), category certificates (if applicable), identity proof, and passport-size photographs to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts at DCBH involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates who perform well in the interview will be considered for appointment.
